subject: Scheduling: Redwood x Skyline Systems — dual-cloud (AWS + GCP) marketplace demo coordination
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyline-systems.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.m@cloudintegrate.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + joint marketplace demo (Redwood x Skyline)

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the chat last week. Skyline is excited to get a joint walkthrough of how Redwood inference shows up in the AWS and GCP marketplace listings — the goal is a short technical runthrough for our field + engineering teams, and a clear checklist for co-sell collateral.

Would you and your SEs be available for a 45-minute session the week of Feb 1–5? We have the following rough windows that work for our team (PT times):

- Tue, Feb 2: 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed, Feb 3: 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu, Feb 4: 09:00–09:45 PT

Attendees from our side: Alex Chen (ops), Priya Malhotra (integration lead), and an AWS co-sell rep (TBD). We can share an agenda and a light pre-reqs spreadsheet.

Thanks — highly flexible on format; happy to co-present or have Redwood lead the demo.

Best,
Alex
Senior Partner Manager, Skyline Systems
(attachment: skyline-aws-reqs.xlsx)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyline-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo (Redwood x Skyline)

Alex —

Appreciate the clear windows. Redwood can take the lead on a 45-minute demo that covers: marketplace listing flow -> runtime/latency profile -> integration checklist for SI -> co-sell handoff. I've attached a draft agenda.

Two slots that look best for our SEs (PT):

- Tue, Feb 2, 10:00–10:45 PT (works for Lauren)
- Wed, Feb 3, 13:00–13:45 PT (works for my calendar but Vanessa flagged a partial conflict)

Can you confirm which of the two is preferred? Also copying Vanessa and Lauren to confirm internal headcount.

Quick ask: please include any marketplace pre-reqs (IAM scopes, test account details) on the shared Drive link so our platform engineer can review in advance.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks —
Rishi
Enterprise GTM, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
(office: +1 415-555-0123)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo (Redwood x Skyline)

Quick note from me — Wed, Feb 3 at 13:00 PT collides with our GCP marketplace readiness sync (we're running a rehearsed demo with the GCP partner team then). Can we do one of these instead?

- Tue, Feb 2, 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
- Thu, Feb 4, 09:00–09:45 PT (backup)

Also propose we structure the session so Skyline covers the integration prerequisites for AWS and Redwood demonstrates the runtime and troubleshooting checklist. That hybrid format helps both SI and cloud field teams.

CC'ing Karthik from Partner Ops to confirm AWS co-sell availability and to loop in the AWS rep.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyline-systems.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.m@cloudintegrate.io>, AWS Co-Sell <aws-cosell@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo (Redwood x Skyline)

Thanks Vanessa — Tue, Feb 2 at 10:00 PT works for our team. Priya just flagged she'd prefer a slightly later slot because she is on IST hours; she can dial in at 13:30 PT but has coverage.

We can keep the session to 45 minutes and record it for anyone who can't join live. I'll upload the pre-req spreadsheet to the Drive link and add the AWS co-sell contact (once I have the name/email I'll forward).

Agenda plan (short):
- 5 min intros (field + SEs)
- 20 min Redwood runtime demo (latency/cost profiles + KV cache walkthrough)
- 10 min Skyline integration checklist (marketplace packaging + IAM)
- 10 min Q&A / next steps (mutual action items)

I'll confirm the attendee list by next week and send a calendar invite.

Best,
Alex
(attachment: skyline-aws-reqs.xlsx - updated)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skyline-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Tue Feb 2, 10:00 PT — Redwood x Skyline dual-cloud demo (calendar follows)

Great — thanks for confirming. I'm booking Tue, Feb 2, 10:00–10:45 PT and will send the calendar invite with Zoom and the Drive materials attached. Please add any additional AWS contacts to the thread when you have them.

Action items before the session:
- Alex / Skyline: upload final pre-reqs and test account info to the Drive folder (assigned)
- Priya / CloudIntegrate: confirm if they need a staging IAM role or will use ephemeral creds
- Karthik (Partner Ops): confirm AWS co-sell rep availability and add to invite
- Lauren (SE): will prepare a 10-min performance slide showing 95th percentile latency across small/medium/large workloads

I'll send the calendar invite in ~30 minutes. If anything changes on your side (time / attendee), reply-all and we'll pivot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Rishi
Enterprise GTM, Redwood Inference
